label: na49_pp_total_yields
purpose: NA49 p+p total multiplicities per inelastic event at 158 GeV/c, the reference of the total-yield readout of the topology and flavor runs (a diagnostic, never a fit statistic).

pi_plus.source: spshadrons.web.cern.ch/ppdata.html, 'Total multiplicities of: pi+ 3.018 / inelastic event'; pp-pi.pdf section 9.3 Total Pion Multiplicity

k_plus.source: spshadrons.web.cern.ch/ppdata.html, 'Total multiplicities of: K+ 0.2267 / inelastic event'

proton.source: spshadrons.web.cern.ch/ppdata.html, 'Total multiplicities of: p 1.1623 / inelastic event'

charged_multiplicity.source: sum of the six charged species above (pi+-, K+-, p, pbar); other charged hadrons (Sigma+-, ...) are not included

feed_down_convention: as published: pions feed-down subtracted (K0S, Lambda, Sigma+-, anti-Lambda), protons and antiprotons corrected for weak hyperon feed-down, kaons without weak feed-down (pp-pi.pdf, pp-proton.pdf section 6.4, pp-kaon.pdf)
uncertainty_note: the papers quote total-yield uncertainties at the few-percent level; the readout compares ratios and does not use them as a likelihood term
